sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap applying a transformation to a value that may not exist — fmap over Nothing always returns Nothing
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to give someone who is gone, it passes through them unchanged into absence.
sketches.draft:
module EverythingITriedToGiveYou where

gift :: a -> Maybe a
gift _ = Nothing

kindness = fmap (+1) (gift 0)
forgiveness = fmap (const True) (gift False)
time = fmap (*forever) (gift 1)
  where forever = undefined

sketches.mechanism: method_missing — Ruby calls this when an object receives a message it has no method for, allowing it to respond to anything without understanding it
sketches.resonance: A person who says yes to everything asked of them, never admitting they don't know how.
sketches.draft:
class Pleaser
  def method_missing(what, *args)
    self
  end

  def respond_to_missing?(*, **)
    true
  end
end

sketches.mechanism: A struct with no fields and a single method that consumes self, making it usable exactly once — Rust's ownership system enforces single-use
sketches.resonance: Some words can only be said once; after you speak them, the capacity to say them is destroyed.
